title: Revenue bands
summary: What your projects take a month now, and the room left in their forecasts next and later, worked out every day and drawn as one bar.

fill.now: The name of the reading that says what a project takes a month today, or a list of names when the same number has arrived under more than one. A reading counts when it is named this, or this, a comma and the project.
fill.base: The name of the reading that says what a project is forecast to take a month a year out, or a list of names. No name may be on both sides, or begin with a name on the other side and a comma.
